C1.name: FROZEN_BASELINE_DRIFT

change_control_assessment.assessment: PERMITTED_WITHOUT_NEW_ECR: every frozen production input is byte-identical to its pin and none was written after the M7 loop start. M7 produced only new artifacts inside its own directory, which is the same PROCESS_ONLY posture ECR-000 already covers (isolated workspace, no production change). NOTE: this covers the *input freeze* only. If A0 later declares MECHANICAL_ENGINEERING_DESIGN_RELEASED and that release supersedes V5R_NEUTRAL_OPERATIONAL_MECHANICAL_BASELINE_V1 as the consumed baseline for Sim13/RL, the policy's V2 class (geometry/mass/frame/collision/configuration change) is engaged and a new ECR plus the 11-item mandatory_v2_regression is required BEFORE any downstream consumer is re-pointed. That is a declared open CM item, not an input-integrity failure.
